children: Laredo Oil, Inc. reported a first-quarter FY2027 loss, with revenue of $0 for the three months ended Aug. 31, 2026, and a consolidated net loss of $(1.61M). Diluted loss per share was $(0.02), compared with a $(0.01) loss per share in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue was $0 for Q1 FY2027, versus $1,543 in the year‑ago quarter.
Net income (loss) was a consolidated net loss of $(1,605,030) for Q1 FY2027, versus a net loss of $(952,074) in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted EPS was a loss of $(0.02) for Q1 FY2027, versus $(0.01) in the year‑ago quarter.
UGD expansion: The company is pursuing international Underground Gravity Drainage projects in Argentina, Mexico, MENA, Romania, Albania and Azerbaijan.
Montana operations: Laredo reduced conventional Montana drilling, disposed of its Hell Creek stake and abandoned most leased acreage, retaining approximately 2,945 net acres.
Well performance issues: Several drilled wells (Lustre, Midfork, Olfert) produced low oil and high water; multiple wells are shut-in pending evaluation or access for disposal.
Partnerships and JVs: Entered a letter of intent in Argentina and executed agreements with Texakoma and Erehwon; Texakoma carried initial wells and paid for additional lease interests.
Fundraising and development: The company is actively raising capital to pursue UGD and Texas opportunities; development of additional wells is paused pending funding and data.
